title: kb-refresh and kb-research step sets ask the old-figure search rule as tested _self questions
goal: Retrospective of SP-avwlotax: ST-nu5b6zqm added to kb-refresh step 3 and kb-research step 3 a search of the root for an old figure a change replaces, but no tested _self question asks it (its worker's pack --item gave coverage none), so rag.py pack --root _self --set kb-refresh:update and --set kb-research:research do not print the rule to the agent at that step. Each set gets a tested lookup_eval.csv row whose question asks where else an old figure is repeated, answered by the skill or kb/_self doc line.

run: import subprocess,sys;o=[subprocess.run([sys.executable,'_tools/rag.py','pack','--root','_self','--set',s],capture_output=True,text=True,check=True).stdout for s in ('kb-refresh:update','kb-research:research')];ok=all('old figure' in x or 'repeats the old' in x for x in o);print('both step sets carry the old-figure rule:',ok);sys.exit(0 if ok else 1)

notes: Premise run 2026-10-12: rag.py pack --root _self --set kb-refresh:update prints ten placeholder and source-id questions and no old-figure line (the check fails). The rule is maintaining.md:41 (the /kb-refresh row: 'repeats the old one'); a row's expect_paths names maintaining.md, its sets column carries kb-refresh:update;kb-research:research, and rag.py eval --root _self stays passing. Landing is code-lane: kb/_self/_retrieval/ is a subdirectory of kb/_self. Planned at the 2026-10-12 draft triage (sprint 2 of 19, "Lookup correctness: router experts, the tag parser and aliases answer what the kb holds"): it serves the fitness tests of EP-gzr4mmkm: a lookup's verdict or the benchmark's measurement is wrong until it is fixed. rag.py eval --root _self passes before the work: it pins that the new row passes.
